description: ASCII '/' that stays because it is not a fraction or a division sign. Rules are enforced in .github/scripts/check-slash-fractions.mjs. Snippets are an explicit backstop for a match the grammar would otherwise report.

rules.reason: Blog posts and blog pages are excluded (Noam, 18.10.2026).
URLs, site paths, href/src values, and import paths.

Comments, non-string code, and <style>. String literals inside <script>, topicFilms, conceptLoops.ts, loopHelpers.ts, landingLoops.ts, kiteAreaFilm.ts, public-lesson/lesson.html, and public JavaScript are scanned. A quotient built at runtime (n + "/" + d, String(a) + "/" + String(b), ${n}/${d}, or Astro {num}/{den}) is a fraction when it is visible text. The same shape in a path, url, href, src, slug, or file join is not, including ${folder}/${name}, ${prefix}/${id}, and ${lang}/${page}. A slash in real code, including Math.floor(m / 5) inside an Astro expression, is not a fraction. CSS lengths (8px / 8px), font shorthand (16px/1.5), and aspect-ratio (4 / 3) are not fractions.
Unit rates such as km/h, m/s, and m/s².

Word pairs such as and/or, w/o, and n/a. Hebrew pairs such as יחידות/סימנים are not quotients: the grammar does not treat Hebrew words as a numerator or a denominator. The snippet below records the review of algebraic-expressions-grade-7.json.

Calendar dates only when the shape is clear: three parts (18/10/2026 or 2026/10/18), or a two-part pair next to a date word (עודכן, תאריך, ביום, בחודש, לוח), such as עודכן ב־18/10. A bare pair is a fraction, including 18/10, 18/12, 13/12, 20/10, and 31/12. A bare 10/2026 is a fraction too; 10/2026 is a date only as the second slash of 18/10/2026.

Clock and duration text such as 0:00 / 0:19 and 12:30 / 13:00. A colon counts as a clock only when a digit sits on both sides (12:30). A fraction followed by a colon, such as 18/12: or ל-3/4:, stays a fraction.
Ratios and division already written with a colon are left as they are.
Step labels such as 01 / מתחילים are a number plus a Hebrew title, not a quotient. The kite-area film uses this form (01 / מתחילים מדלתון).
math-tools.json removedOrphans text 3/4 is an editing leftover that is not rendered.
Breadcrumb separators such as בית / כיתה are a lone '/' between Hebrew words, not a numerator over a denominator.

A spaced game score N / 100, such as 7 / 100, is a score out of 100. A tight fraction stays a fraction, including p/100 and 8/100. The public lesson shows a live score out of 300 with the same spaced slash; that one line is a snippet because the total is 300, not 100.

snippets.reason: Hebrew pair 'units/signs'. Not a quotient. The grammar already ignores Hebrew words; this entry records the review.
Live score out of 300. The numerator sits in #scoreBig and the slash is a score separator, the same role as N / 100. Not a quotient.
Base64-encoded inner frame payload inside atob(...), not visible text or a quotient.
